research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Bellabeat is researching wearable smart jewelry and a smart hybrid watch that use a three axis accelerometer, onboard memory, and a processor to capture and process position and acceleration data for women’s health tracking. It is also developing a smart heart tracker that combines motion sensing with an optical biosensor for heart rate monitoring, and a smart bottle system that uses accelerometer and load sensor data to quantify liquid intake, covering activity, cardiac metrics, and hydration monitoring.

overview_description.description: Bellabeat, top 5 Y-COMBINATOR  company in the W14  class,  is a data-centered wellness femtech company behind some of the most fashionably designed tech-powered wellness products and one of the fastest-growing wellness subscription services for women. Throughout the years, Bellabeat built the go-to wellness brand with a compelling ecosystem of solutions and services focused on women’s health. The success of the Leaf and Ivy wearables enabled the brand to expand to international markets and kickstart industry discussions on the importance of innovating in the design and development of tech products. Today, Bellabeat is leading the market shift with hyper-personalized holistic wellness offerings aligned with a women’s menstrual cycle.
